experiment: AntMaze V6 mainline, clip recipe: the current (clipped CF) agents as continuation at the same anchors -- futures profile (A), gated paired continuation (B)

A_generation.anchors: the pilot anchor set, every anchor
A_generation.hazard_seed: HAZARD_SEED0 + anchor_id (identical to the old file: paired by anchor)
A_generation.continuation: the lineage agent, mode tanh(loc), closed-loop to reach / death / horizon

A_profile.paired_by: anchor (same state, same query torque, same hazard draw)
quantities: entered the far route after the query (y >= 6 at x < 2)
completed the far route (entered and reached the goal)
the critic goal marginal under the truncated geometric law: mass in the far-route legs / goal area / hazard zones
strata: logged shortcut / detour episodes x start region

B_gate.quantity: far route completed (entered the far route after the query and the branch reached the goal), anchor-weighted share
B_gate.rule: new - old > 0 in 3/3 lineages AND the mean over the 3 lineages >= 0.02 (absolute); the start-agent share is the same file for every lineage

B_design.source: the lineage final (full TrainingState: params, target, policy and critic Adam states incl. the clip state, key)
B_design.streams: critic and actor streams fast-forwarded by 30,000 batches (the run continues its own sequence)

arms.CFold: the start-agent futures (branches_cf.npz): the plain continuation of the run

B_design.held_fixed: the sealed critic_clip0.1 recipe: NCE, actor loss, bc 0.05, gamma 0.999, lr, clip 0.1, batch 1024, anchors and weights, actor stream, evaluation (seed 3909, 300, mode)
B_design.no_restart: nothing re-initialised; the round-2 confound (restart vs futures) is absent

B_comparisons.primary: CFnew - CFold success, paired on the common episodes per lineage; rule: mean over the 3 lineages > 2 x seed s.e. and 3/3

no_selection: every lineage, both arms, the final checkpoints evaluated once; the gate is evaluated mechanically before any training
status: oracle (simulator) futures under the disclosed optimizer-stabilisation recipe; not a learned-ETT result
